YFC USA runs a shared WordPress MULTISITE for chapter websites. coyfc.org, redriveryfc.com, yfclincoln.org and yfcmv.org all serve assets from /wp-content/uploads/sites/<N>/ (28, 38, ...) and carry the same numbered page titles ('00 — Home', '01 — About', '03 — Give', '99 — Find a Ministry'). Repeatable paths on any chapter in the network: /our-staff/, /about/, /ministries/, /ministry/<slug>/, /give/, /careers/. This is the highest-value repeatable surface in the slice: enumerate the chapter list at https://yfc.net/chapter/ and hit /our-staff/ and /about/ on each.

Non-multisite chapters run Squarespace (statelineyfc.org/staff, yfcirc.com/staff + /team-bios) or Weebly-style flat HTML (cvyouth.org/our-team.html). Path shapes /staff, /team-bios, /our-team.html. All are single-page rosters — no per-person profile slugs on any chapter site checked.

https://yfc.net/chapter/ — national chapter directory (yfc.net/chapter/<area-slug>/, e.g. /denver-area-yfc/, /lincoln-area/, /itasca-area/, /yfc-new-york-ny/, /mid-valley-or-area/). Chapter-level, not person-level; this is the seed list for a chapter sweep, not a source of people.

https://usa.yfc.net/give/ — YFC USA's central donor portal. It DOES support gifts designated to a named staff member, but only through a last-name SEARCH FORM, not per-person URLs. Query-string form: not a citable per-person page. Worth a fetch pass to see whether the search resolves to stable per-staff URLs.

https://give.yfci.org/donate-now?staffId=52900 — YFC International giving keys staff by opaque numeric staffId in a query string. Not a hit per the wave rule (query-string + numeric ID, no name in URL). Also the international arm, not a US local chapter.
https://give.yfcnin.org/give/282520/ — chapter-level give.<chapter>.org subdomain with a numeric fund ID, not a person slug. Same shape likely on other chapters' give.* subdomains.
https://denver.yfc.net/give and https://yfcdenver.org/ — Denver Area runs both a yfc.net subdomain and its own domain. <city>.yfc.net subdomains are a second chapter URL family worth sweeping.
https://redriveryfc.com/about/staff/ — titled 'Staff Letters'. Support-letter index; could carry per-person pages. Not resolved within budget — fetch pass.

https://yfcmp.org/about-us/our-team/, https://www.cvyouth.org/our-team.html, https://coyfc.org/our-board-of-trustees/, https://www.yfcirc.com/bod, https://www.statelineyfc.org/staff — roster pages confirmed to exist; search snippets returned only partial name lists. All are fetch-pass targets for a complete roster.
yfcteens.com (Palm Beach County), yfcmv.org (Miami Valley), yfc.ca/winnipeg (Canada), yfcfoundation.org — chapter/affiliate domains surfaced but not mined within budget.

needs_review.issue: No per-person giving URL exists anywhere in the YFC chapter network
needs_review.finding: YFC does centralise giving, but not into per-person pages. usa.yfc.net/give exposes staff-designated giving through a last-name SEARCH FORM; give.yfci.org keys staff by opaque numeric ?staffId=; give.<chapter>.org uses numeric fund IDs. No chapter site checked (statelineyfc.org, coyfc.org, redriveryfc.com, yfclincoln.org, yfcirc.com, yfcmp.org, cvyouth.org) publishes per-person staff profile or giving slugs.
needs_review.recommendation: Every record in this file is therefore staff_directory/medium rather than personal_page/high. Run a fetch pass on usa.yfc.net/give to test whether the staff-search resolves to a stable per-staff URL — if it does, that single platform is the entire ~160-chapter roster and is the highest-value fetch in the wave.

needs_review.finding: Stateline YFC lists 'Courtney' (Director of Operations) and "D'Lisa" (City Life Director) with no surname in any snippet. YFC Metro Pittsburgh's Washington location lists 'Stephen and Kace' as staff with no surnames.
needs_review.recommendation: Held out under the first-name/initials rule. A fetch of those two pages would likely resolve the surnames; these are almost certainly display-truncation rather than deliberate anonymisation, but do not infer.

needs_review.finding: https://yfcmp.org/showing-up-where-it-counts-a-conversation-with-chris-thompson/ names Chris Thompson in the URL slug and title, but the page is an interview article — he could be staff, a volunteer, a partner or a donor.
needs_review.recommendation: Not emitted. Check https://yfcmp.org/about-us/our-team/ for Chris Thompson before treating him as staff.

needs_review.issue: Tier A applied to chapter back-office roles without direct support-raising evidence
needs_review.finding: Central Ohio YFC's Director of Finance (Linda Hanes), Director of Operations & HR (Leslie Goldsberry), Executive Assistant (Reba Brookes) and COO (Michele Davis) are graded Tier A on YFC's support-raising model, following the enumeration rule that forbids tiering down on job function alone. No YFC document in evidence states that chapter administrative staff raise their own support.
needs_review.recommendation: Confirm against a YFC chapter employment/support-raising policy page before treating these four as equivalent to field staff.
